name: AbraSilver Resource Corp.
description: AbraSilver Resource Corp. is a Canadian silver-gold development company advancing the Diablillos project in Salta Province, Argentina. The project is fully permitted with a Definitive Feasibility Study completed in June 2026, positioning it as a primary silver producer targeting first production in 2029. The company also holds an earn-in option on the La Coipita copper-gold project in San Juan Province, Argentina, through a joint venture with Teck.
